method: Each repository was shallow-cloned into an isolated folder and dissected with REA 6.8.0 (MCP analyze_javascript_application / inspect_artifact where they apply) plus manual reading of plain source; the most valuable new capabilities were re-implemented natively under scripts/fusion/ with self-tests. Upstream code is not executed or vendored.

repos.summary_ar: مكتبة أساليب أفلام لوكلاء البرمجة: كل أسلوب معاه ملف تعليمات وفيلم تجريبي معمول بالكود بالكامل فوق عدة أدوات مشتركة (صفحة بترسم الفريم كدالة في الزمن وبتتصوّر فريم فريم في كروم مخفي، صوت راوي بفحص تفريغ، موسيقى من عينات وتركيب، مؤثرات صوتية مولّدة، وماستر صوت -14 LUFS على مرحلتين)، ومعاها منهج إخراج مكتوب وسكربتات فحص جودة (وقت القراءة، تطابق القطعات مع الموسيقى، تقرير الإيقاع، نعومة الكاميرا).
repos.summary_en: A library of film styles for coding agents: each style ships a STYLE.md prompt and a demo film made entirely in code on a shared toolkit (deterministic render(t) pages captured frame by frame in headless Chrome, Kokoro/edge-tts voice with a Whisper check, sampled and synthesized score, procedural foley, two-pass -14 LUFS mastering), plus a DIRECTOR.md method and per-demo QA scripts (reading time, cue check, rhythm report, camera smoothness).

capabilities.title_en: Rhythm report of a finished film
capabilities.what: Motion energy per frame, hard-cut spikes over a local median, flat 1-s windows, spectral-flux onsets, RMS per 0.5 s, near-silences, offset of every visual hit to the nearest audio onset
capabilities.notes: native_opuscar.py rhythm; scipy replaced by numpy median and peak code; adds pace-variation and silence flags

capabilities.what: Each on-screen text must stay fully in frame for CJK/4.5 + other/15 + 1.5 s (min 1.5); pass:true texts not timed; never-fully-visible text fails
capabilities.notes: native port adds an Arabic rate (12 cps, harakat ignored), SRT input and the 4 s title rule

capabilities.what: Every cue >= 1.8 s and >= spoken part + 0.6 s
capabilities.notes: readcheck kind=subtitle and lint

capabilities.what: Hook <= 3 s, >= 4 camera moves, a signature shot, a why per shot, >= 2 silences, >= 2 J/L sound transitions, varied pace with a breath, title >= 4 s, a native move, not-the-demo-again >= 4/6 axes differ
capabilities.notes: rules from DIRECTOR.md sections 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 11

capabilities.title_en: Two-pass -14 LUFS master with true-peak loop
capabilities.title_ar: ماستر صوت على مرحلتين مع حماية الذروة
capabilities.what: Two-pass loudnorm with measured_* values, 192 kHz oversampled alimiter with latency compensation, audio-only re-encode until true peak <= -1 dBTP, damaged/truncated WAV detection, atomic output
capabilities.notes: Dragon already verifies loudness (verify_video.py); this adds the fix loop

capabilities.title_en: Deterministic render(t) page contract and parallel capture
capabilities.what: window.DUR/render(t)/READY/EV/TEXTS; N workers each with its own browser, JPEG screenshots piped to ffmpeg, segments joined losslessly, per-output lock
capabilities.notes: Dragon has render-html/starter-html-canvas; the TEXTS(t) and EV exports are the new part

capabilities.what: One timeline JSON (sections, bpm, beats, hits) read by score and picture; prints delta ms per cue, aim 0
capabilities.notes: partly covered by the native rhythm alignment

capabilities.what: Samples window.CAM at 4x fps: screen speed, acceleration, jerk; fails on velocity jumps outside declared shakes, subjects leaving frame or entering the subtitle strip, or the whole set seen before the reveal
numpy/scipy click, clack, whoosh, thump, ding, pop, rumble, heartbeat, radio, plus compress, look-ahead limit and equal-power add(buf, x, at, gain, pan)
Events (time, instrument, pitch, dur, vel, pan) to audio from VSCO2CE/VCSL/FreePats/Salamander with round-robin, seamless note extension, room reverb, credits()
capabilities.notes: needs sample packs via tools/fetch.sh

capabilities.title_en: TTS line ASR check with number normalisation
capabilities.what: faster-whisper per line; English word match with numbers spelled; CJK by character similarity with numbers compared by value; writes word timings
capabilities.notes: the number-by-value idea is reusable for Arabic numerals

capabilities.what: mulberry seeded RNG, hash, vnoise, ss/eio/eo/ei/back/spring easing, Fritsch-Carlson monotone cubic, multi-dim track(), env envelope
capabilities.notes: Dragon motion-toolkit covers most; monotone track() is the useful part

capabilities.what: Hold text letters/15 + 1.5 s, title 4 s, subtitle 1.8 s; two silences before the peak; J/L cut twice; one breath and one acceleration

repos.summary_ar: مهارة لـ Claude Code وCodex بتعمل فيديوهات دعاية سينمائية لمنتجات الويب بـ Remotion: فيها 124 كارت وصفة لقطات معاها كود TSX متظبط، وقالب جاهز اسمه Ink Press، وطريقة لضبط القطعات على إيقاع الموسيقى، وجلب مؤثرات صوتية من Freesound، وهيكل منحنى طاقة للستوري بورد، وقائمة مراجعة نهائية مستقلة، وورشة تعديل شبه جيانيينج، وتصدير الفيلم النهائي لمشروع جيانيينج (CapCut الصيني) قابل للتعديل.
repos.summary_en: Claude Code / Codex skill for cinematic web-product promos in Remotion: 124 shot recipe cards with tuned TSX demos, a finished Ink Press template, a beat-grid sync method, Freesound SFX sourcing, an energy-arc storyboard skeleton, an independent final-review checklist, a JianYing-style Motion Workbench and an export of the finished film into an editable JianYing (CapCut CN) draft.

capabilities.what: Frame timeline to microsecond plate cuts (start and end rounded separately so adjacent segments never gap or overlap), merged cross-shot captions, one text track per language, greedy SFX lanes, CSS px to JianYing size / transform_y / float colour.
capabilities.notes: native_shotcraft.py jy-plan

capabilities.what: Emits a runnable pyJianYingDraft 0.3.x script from the plan (tracks: plate, BGM, captions per language, SFX lanes).
capabilities.notes: native_shotcraft.py jy-script; pyJianYingDraft needed in a venv, not vendored

capabilities.title_ar: مثبّت آمن لمشروع جيانيينج على ويندوز
capabilities.what: Refuses traversal names and runs only when JianyingPro.exe is closed; bundles media into Resources/ with NFC+casefold unique names; moves an old draft into a nested trash dir; rolls back on failure; verifies media live inside the draft.

repos.summary_ar: مكتبة JavaScript من غير أي اعتماديات فيها حوالي 244 مؤثر بكسل آرت مرسوم بالكود (نار، انفجارات، تلج، برق، انتقالات، طقس، واجهات). كل مؤثر بيترسم في طبقتين: طبقة لون بكسلاتها متدرّجة بدِثر Bayer، وطبقة ضوء بتتجمع فوقها. وفيها محاكاة جسيمات بتشتغل على 120 هرتز، وباليتات ألوان بدرجات مايلة في اللون، وتجميد لحظة الضربة مع الاهتزاز، وتصدير sprite sheet، ومهارة لـ Claude Code ماشية بدورة: مسودة ثم رندر ثم بص ثم حسّن.
repos.summary_en: Dependency-free JS library of ~244 procedural pixel-art VFX (fire, explosions, ice, lightning, transitions, weather, UI) drawn into a colour buffer (Bayer-dithered pixels) plus an additive light buffer, with a 120 Hz particle sim, hue-shifted palette ramps, hit-stop acting, sprite-sheet export and a Claude Code draft-render-look-refine skill.

capabilities.title_ar: دمج طبقة لون وطبقة ضوء بتتجمع فوقها
capabilities.what: Effects draw opaque/dithered pixels into a colour buffer and glow into a light buffer; composite adds light over footage, or over transparency turns light into premultiplied colour with alpha = brightest channel.
capabilities.notes: native_pixelfx.py composite(); self-test checks alpha from light.

capabilities.what: Pixels at alpha < 1 are drawn only where alpha exceeds the 4x4 Bayer threshold, keeping hard pixel-art edges.
capabilities.notes: Frame.dot(); Dragon already has Bayer fades in fam_pixel_retro_stylized.py, this is the per-pixel draw variant.

capabilities.title_en: Pixel-art particle physics (spark, fire, smoke, ember)
capabilities.title_ar: فيزياء جسيمات بكسل آرت (شرار، نار، دخان، جمر)
capabilities.what: Sparks streak and bounce off the floor, fire puffs cool down a ramp and leave smoke, smoke is three soft discs, embers drift and flicker.
capabilities.notes: Particles class + presets explosion/sparks/campfire/embers in native_pixelfx.py fx.

capabilities.what: Simulations step at 120 Hz or finer whatever the output fps, so renders match across frame rates.
capabilities.notes: Particles.update().

capabilities.title_en: Hue-shifted palette ramps and no-blend ramp mapping
capabilities.title_ar: باليتات متدرجة بإزاحة لونية وتلوين على درجات من غير مزج
capabilities.what: 28 dark-to-bright ramps whose shadows lean cool and highlights warm; fit() resamples a ramp keeping its ends; at() picks a step without blending.
capabilities.notes: PAL subset + ramp-map subcommand (luma -> ramp with Bayer dither); --palette recolours fire.

capabilities.title_en: Hit-stop freeze with decaying shake and 12 fps holds
capabilities.title_ar: تجميد لحظة الضربة مع اهتزاز بيهدى ولقطات ثابتة على 12 فريم
capabilities.what: At a hit, time stands still for a few frames while the picture shakes with sin/cos jitter on 60 Hz steps that decays to zero; poses hold on 12 fps beats.
capabilities.notes: hitstop subcommand on real footage, --step 12 for animated-on-twos.

capabilities.what: Two frames of ink-on-paper burst, two inverted, then burst lines pulling out past the edges.
capabilities.notes: hitstop --impact applies 2 two-tone + 2 inverted frames to footage (burst lines not ported).

capabilities.what: Transparent frames in a grid plus JSON with frame rects, frameTags, fps and pivot, readable by Phaser, Godot and Unity importers.
capabilities.notes: fx --sheet.

capabilities.what: Any scalar field over the screen plus inverse-gradient distance and a sorted pixel order gives shaped wipes with an even-width glowing edge.
capabilities.notes: Good next port: generic shaped transition between two clips.

capabilities.what: Mixed-size blocks (20/10/5 px) wink in and out at times ranked from fbm noise, so they gather in growing patches, with glints.
Picture squeezes into a white-hot humming line, then a dot afterglow; switching on reverses it with a warm-up refresh band.
capabilities.notes: Dragon has a CRT look (ffmpeg); this is the timed on/off transition.

capabilities.title_en: Tileable and looping noise for seamless loops
capabilities.title_ar: ضوضاء بتتكرر من غير فواصل علشان اللوبات
capabilities.what: tileNoise/tileFbm repeat every N cells so a scrolled field loops without a seam; loopNoise samples a circle so phase 0 equals phase 1.

capabilities.title_en: VFX lint: seams, off-canvas, unseeded randomness
capabilities.title_ar: فاحص مؤثرات: الفواصل والرسم برا الكانفاس والعشوائية من غير seed
capabilities.what: Checks effects for missing meta, pixels outside the canvas, one-shots that don't end empty, loops with a seam, Math.random use and slow frames.
capabilities.notes: Idea transferable to Dragon motion QA.

capabilities.title_ar: مهارة مؤثرات بدورة مسودة ثم رندر ثم بص ثم تحسين
capabilities.what: Claude Code skill: find an existing effect first, re-option it (palette, seed, flip), else draft a new one, render a contact sheet, look at it, refine.
capabilities.notes: Method credit Hugo Duprez (Sprite Fusion).

repos.summary_ar: عدّة ودليل مكتوب للوكيل يعمل كرتون قصير مرسوم باليد بفرشاة p5.brush: كل فريم دالة نقية في الزمن، والخطوط بتترعش (boil) 12 رسمة في الثانية من بذرة ثابتة لكل عنصر، ومساعدات تمثيل جاهزة (مشاعر بتمهيد ورد فعل، نطّ، سوست، أقواس، لفّ بمناظر مرسومة)، وريندر بكروم مخفي بيطلّع شيت لقطات، وشريط لكل فريم، وقصّ بيتبع نقطة في المشهد، وفريمات بالتوازي تكمل من مكان ما وقفت.
repos.summary_en: A kit and written guide for agents to make short hand-painted 2D cartoons in p5.brush: every frame is a pure function of time, linework 'boils' at 12 drawings a second from per-element seeds, acting helpers (emotions with anticipation and takes, jumps, springs, arcs, turns through drawn key views) are closed-form, and a puppeteer-core renderer produces contact sheets, every-frame strips, camera-following crops and parallel, resumable, atomic JPEG frames encoded by ffmpeg.

capabilities.title_ar: جدول «القراءات» وفحص التوقيت من عين المشاهد
capabilities.what: Storyboard format where each shot lists timed reads (what the viewer must understand); checks one read at a time, enough time per read (longer for small/far/fast/subtle), no dead stretch, final read held, transition at every seam, no text.
capabilities.notes: native_cab.py reads-lint; duration thresholds are our heuristic, the guide gives rules not numbers.

capabilities.title_ar: بذرة رعشة لكل عنصر (رعشة يدوية ثابتة)
capabilities.what: Linework re-randomised 12x/s; each element reseeds from FNV-1a(key|boilIndex) so a moving element cannot shift the random stream of still ones.
capabilities.notes: native_cab.py seed reproduces the JS hash bit-exactly (verified with node).

capabilities.title_en: Boil jitter and freeze audit on rendered frames
capabilities.title_ar: فحص رعشة الخطوط والتجميد في الفريمات
capabilities.what: QA check derived from the guide's strip review: within a boil drawing, still regions must not change; compares same-boil vs cross-boil pixel change and finds frozen stretches.
capabilities.notes: Upstream only describes a visual check; the measurement is ours.

capabilities.title_en: Frames as pure functions of time + determinism check
capabilities.title_ar: الفريم دالة نقية في الزمن + فحص الثبات
capabilities.what: Shot fn(t, lt, dur) paints the whole frame with no carried state, so frames render in parallel and out of order; shots() picks the active shot by start time.
capabilities.notes: native_cab.py same compares two renders frame by frame (proves the contract was kept).

capabilities.title_ar: ريندر فريمات بالتوازي، يكمّل بعد الانقطاع، وكتابة آمنة
capabilities.what: N headless pages pull the next missing frame; frames <1000 bytes count as missing; each written to .tmp then renamed; ETA log; separate ffmpeg encode with optional audio.
capabilities.notes: native_cab.py todo ports the missing-frame logic; worker pool itself stays upstream (puppeteer).

capabilities.title_en: Contact sheet, every-frame strip and world-point-following crop
capabilities.title_ar: شيت لقطات، شريط كل فريم، وقصّ بيتبع نقطة في العالم
capabilities.what: renderSheet renders chosen times or every frame in a span into a labelled grid; crop = fixed region at full res; crop-at maps a world point through each frame's camera (toScreen with LAST_CAM) to follow a foot or prop.
capabilities.notes: Crop-at needs the scene camera, so it belongs inside the renderer, not a post tool. video-eyes covers plain strips.

capabilities.title_en: Headless Chrome GPU backend selection and probe
capabilities.title_ar: اختيار كارت الشاشة لكروم المخفي وفحصه
capabilities.what: Per-OS ANGLE flags (d3d11/metal/angle), --soft-gl SwiftShader, --gpu-angle vulkan|gl-egl for headless NVIDIA Linux; gpu_probe prints the unmasked WebGL renderer per flag set.
capabilities.notes: Our cartoon kit hard-codes SwiftShader (3-10 s/frame); d3d11 on this Windows box should be much faster.

capabilities.title_en: Acted emotion changes (anticipation, squint, take, overshoot)
capabilities.title_ar: تغيير المشاعر بالتمثيل (تمهيد، تغميض، رد فعل، تجاوز)
capabilities.what: emotions(t, keys) wraps each mood change in anticipation squash, face swap under a squint, a take scaled per emotion, overshoot settle and colour cross-fade; 31 emotions each with beat-locked idle body motion.
capabilities.notes: Pattern is portable to any rig: never swap faces between two frames.

capabilities.what: jump (crouch, stretch, arc, squash-land), take, stroll, spring/ring damped follow-through, arcPt, onTwos, pulse/beatN beat lock, kf keyframes.
capabilities.notes: motion-toolkit already has easing/keyframes/jitter; jump/take/spring/ring/onTwos are the new pieces.

capabilities.title_en: Painted brush-wipe and shaped iris transitions
capabilities.what: brushWipe(p): 5 staggered ragged strokes cover (0-.5) then drag off (.5-1), cut under full cover; irisShape paints outside any polygon (star, keyhole).
capabilities.notes: Needs p5.brush for the painted look.

capabilities.title_en: Paper texture, multiplied grain and additive glow over pigment
capabilities.title_ar: خامة ورق، حبيبات بالضرب، وتوهّج مضاف فوق الألوان
capabilities.what: Seeded LCG paper (stains + fibres) under the frame, grain+vignette multiplied on top, glow() as the one additive mark because pigment mixing turns yellow-on-blue green.
capabilities.notes: Cheap look recipe portable to any canvas renderer.

capabilities.title_en: Agent animation rulebook and common-failures checklist
capabilities.title_ar: كتاب قواعد التحريك للوكيل وقائمة الأخطاء الشائعة
capabilities.what: Three goals (handmade, alive, one piece), 7 rules, 11 animation principles incl. avoid twinning, review budget, 15 common failures of generated animation.
capabilities.notes: Text rules; the no-text rule must yield to Arabic kinetic-type briefs.

modules.name: shotcraft
modules.purpose: Promo energy arc, gated beat grid (LSQ, half/double), render audio-lag, SFX peak placement, JianYing/CapCut draft planner + safe Windows installer.

modules.name: pixelfx
modules.purpose: Pixel-art VFX over real footage (explosion, sparks, campfire, embers) with additive light, hit-stop + shake + anime impact frame, hue-shifted palette ramp mapping, sprite sheets.

modules.name: cab
modules.purpose: Viewer "reads" storyboard lint, line-boil jitter audit, FNV-1a boil seed (bit-exact with JS), missing-frame todo, render determinism check.

modules.name: blender_audit
modules.purpose: Headless Blender scene audit (real size, grounded/floating, mesh health, rig weights, missing textures, unapplied scale) + Poly Haven CC0 search/resolve.

modules.name: three
modules.purpose: Deterministic three.js/TSL frame rendering: virtual clock shim, WebGPU/WebGL frame harness + Playwright driver, node catalog.

modules.name: rapier_bake
modules.purpose: Deterministic 2D rigid-body bake (fixed 120 Hz steps, frame clock, collisions with frame numbers for SFX, sleep, friction, spin) → per-frame transforms JSON.

modules.name: musicmap
modules.purpose: Music map for montage: tempo, beats, downbeats, sections, drops, climax, energy curve, strong cut points, key (HPSS + chroma/MFCC segmentation + PLP).

modules.name: promptlib
modules.purpose: Searchable index of 703 code-as-video prompt cases (links + metadata) and a 12-rule video-prompt linter.
